assumptions_challenged: That MISEV2023 guidance can be used as a sole evidentiary basis to determine program readiness for advancement without direct program CMC/analytical records
That absence of supplied program-specific CMC/analytics/batch data equals program inability to meet the requested Stage-1 criteria
That the program lead has not already generated fit-for-purpose intact-EV assays, MCB/WCB, or GMP-like batches (i.e., supplied materials are comprehensive)
falsification_conditions: Provision of program-specific, dated MCB/WCB generation and characterization records showing identity, traceability, and stability across seed lots
Delivery of validated intact-EV assay validation reports (orthogonal QC panel) including LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy, and suitability in relevant biological matrices
Demonstration documents for a stability-indicating potency assay showing correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint (data and statistical linkage)
Three or more GMP-like batch records with release test results, stability datasets, and lot-to-lot comparability analyses showing consistent identity, purity, and potency

Bridging biodistribution/PK datasets applying the same validated intact-EV assays across rodent and at least one larger species (with controls demonstrating assay specificity for intact EV versus non-vesicular particles)
strongest_objection: The review’s conclusions depend on the absence of program-specific CMC/assay/batch data as evidence of insufficiency; absence of those records in the supplied materials is not the same as verified failure of the program to have generated them. Without program-specific documentation, the gate recommendation may be premature if relevant data exist but were not provided for review.
